name: Stephanas
overview: Stephanas is identified in Scripture as a devoted Christian in Corinth whose household was baptized by the Apostle Paul, highlighting their early commitment to Christ's gospel. Paul refers to the household of Stephanas as the firstfruits of Achaia, emphasizing their role as among the first converts in the region who dedicated themselves to serving fellow believers. The arrival of Stephanas, along with Fortunatus and Achaicus, is noted with joy by Paul because they helped address needs within the Corinthian church, demonstrating their active ministry and faithful support.
